newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank Nova Scotia Q1 loan loss falls.
newsitem.headline: Bank Nova Scotia Q1 loan loss falls.

text.p: Bank of Nova Scotia said on Tuesday its first-quarter loan losses charged to income fell to C$89 million from C$95 million a year ago.

The bank said in releasing earnings that decreasing interest rates, favorable economic conditions and continued improvement in net impaired loans enabled Scotiabank to reduce its estimated annual provision for loan losses to C$355 million for fiscal 1997 ending October 31 from C$380 million in 1996. Net impaired loans outstanding declined to C$690 million at January 31 from C$743 million in the fourth quarter.
